# Related projects

Other public work on the same game. Facts about formats are shared freely; code from these projects is not copied into
Five Star Recomp, except that the BCPack BC1 decoder is based on bcpack-rs under its MIT license
(`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`).

| Project | Focus | License |
|---|---|---|
| [ItsNotRexed/Leonida](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida) | full recompilation effort: shaders to SPIR-V for Vulkan, asset export (models, audio), D3D12.X on Vulkan | GPL-3.0-or-later |
| [realdody/americas-recomp](https://github.com/realdody/americas-recomp) (`xbox-series` branch) | RDNA shaders to SPIR-V, Xbox D3D12 device proxy, Xbox DXIL lowering | GPL-2.0-only |
| [holdmysocks/SixNG](https://github.com/holdmysocks/SixNG) | RPF9 extraction notes, BCPack header notes | README only |
| [R0Y00/Xbox2Windows](https://github.com/R0Y00/Xbox2Windows) | BCPack constant-lane probe | see repository |
| [Ahmet-Dedeler/bcpack-rs](https://github.com/Ahmet-Dedeler/bcpack-rs) | BCPack decoder (BC1), its spec and fitted BC1 tables; our BC1 decoder is based on it | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
